content: Seikop Kaunopada pwe en Tuhwong Esau
Nindokon Seikop eh wiewia eh seiloak, tohnleng en Koht kei ahpw tuhwong.
Eri, ni eh kilangirailda eh ahpw patohwan, “Iet karis en Koht kei.” E ahpw kihong eden wasao Mahanaim.
Seikop eri kadarala mwowe meninkeder kei rehn rie Esau nan wehin Edom.
E kehkehlingkihong meninkeder ko re en ndaiong Esau, “Iet ngehi, Seikop, sapwellimomwi ladu, me patohwan pakairkiwohng ei kaun Esau duwen ei keikeiruier rehn Lapan oh mihmihte reh lel rahnwet.
Mie rehi nei pelin kou, pelin ahs, pelin sihpw oh kuht, oh pil kiden lidu ohl oh lih. I patohwanowohng komwi, maing, pakair wet, pwe I en diar kalahngan pahn kupwuromwi.”
Meninkeder ko pwurodo rehn Seikop oh patohwanohng, “Se patohla rehn riomwi Esau, ahpw iet e ketiket kohdo rehmwi iangahki aramas 400.”
Seikop eri masepwehkada kowahlap, oh nehkpeseng aramas me mihmi reh ko, oh pil nah pelin sihpw oh kuht, pelin kou oh kamel ko, wiahkihda pwihn riau.
E ahpw mengimengloalki, “Ma Esau pahn peiong ehu pwihn, a pwihn teio kakete pitlahsang.”

Seikop eri kapakap, patohwan, “Maing Koht en semei Eipraam, Koht en semei Aisek, komw ketin karong ie! Maing KAUN, komw ketin mahsanihongieier, ‘Pwurowei nan sapwomw rehn kisehmw kan, I ahpw pahn kupwuramwahwihiuk.’

I sohte warohng kalahngan koaros oh loalopwoat poatopoat me komw ketin kupwurehki sapwellimomwi ladu menet. I kotelahr Pillap Sordan sohte wa mehkot ihte sokon pwoat, a met I pwurodohr kahre pwihn riau wet.
Komw ketin doareiesang ni manaman en riei Esau. I perki ni eh patopatohdo pwe ede uhwong kiht oh kauweikitala koaros, iangahki lih akan oh pil seri kan.

Komw kupwukupwure sapwellimomwi inowo me mahsanih, ‘I pahn kupwuramwhwihiuk pwe mehkoaros en pweida rehmw, oh I pahn kihong uhk kadaudokomw ngedehrie me soh kak wadawad. Re pahn tohto duwehte pihken ni oaroahr akan.’”
Eri, mwurin eh pweidi wasao nipwongo, e pilada sang nan dipwisou ko me mihmi reh kisakis me e pahn kihong rie Esau.
Eri, iet kan: kuht lih 200 oh kuht wol 20, sihpw lih 200 oh sihpw wol 20,
kamel lih me apwtehn neitik 30 iangahki wahrail kan, kou lih 40 oh kouwol 10, ahs lih 20 oh ahs wol 10.
E ahpw nehkpeseng pelinmen pwukat rehn ladu kei, oh ndaiong irail, “Kumwail tiengwei mwohi, oh dehr kapatapene pelinmen kan, ahpw irepeseng ehute soangen mahn ekis wasa.
E ahpw pil kehkehlingkihong ladu me tiengo, “Ni omw pahn tuhwong riei Esau oh eh pahn idek rehmw, ‘Ihs me omw soumas? Ke pahn mi ia? Nein ihs mahn pwukat me ke kahkahre?
Ke pahn sapengki, ‘En sapwellimomwi ladu Seikop eh tungoal mahn pwukat. Eh tungoal kisakis me e patohwan kadarodohng komwi, maing. Pein ih patopato kohdo mwurit.’”

E ahpw pil wiahiong soangen kehkehlikohte ong keriemen, oh pil kesilimen, oh koaros me idihdawehn pelinmen ko, e ndaiong irail, “Ih soangen pato wette me kumwail pahn patohwanohng Esau, ni amwail pahn tuhwong.

Kumwail pil pahn ndahng, ‘Ei, sapwellimomwi ladu Seikop patopatohdo mwurit.’” Seikop ahpw mengimengloalki, “I pahn kameleileikihdi Esau kisakis pwukat me pahn tiengla mwohi, oh ni ei pahn tuhwong, ele e pahn kadekohng ie oh mahkohng ie.”
Kisakis ko eri pekederla mwowe, a ih e pweidi nipwongo nan imwe impwalo.
Seikop Poadoarohng Aramas emen nan Peniel
Nipwongohte Seikop pwourda oh ale eh pwoud riemeno, eh lih lidu riemeno, oh nah seri 11 ko oh kotehla Pillap Sappok.
Mwurin eh kadarihralahr, e ahpw pil kadarala eh kepwe ko koaros.
Ih eri kelekelepw wasao. A iet ohl emen ahpw pwarohng oh poadoarohng lao lel nin sohrahn.
Ni ohlo eh pehmada me e sohte kak kesehdi, e poakih pwonen Seikopo. Eri, pwonen Seikopo ahpw piselpeseng.
Ohlo ahpw nda, “Eri, pweisang ie, pwe wasa rahnehr.” A Seikop sapeng, nda, “I sohte pahn pweisang uhk, ke lao pahn kapaiaiehda.”
Ohlo ahpw idek reh, “Ia edomw?” Seikop ahpw sapeng, “Seikop.”
Ohlo ahpw ndahng, “Ke solahr pahn adaneki Seikop. Pwe ke poadoarongehr Koht oh aramas akan, ke ahpw powedier. Eri, ke pahn adanekilahr Israel.”
Seikop ahpw idek, “A komwi, ia mwaromwi?” A e sapeng, “Dahme ke idengki mwarei?” Ih eri kapaiahda Seikop wasao.
Seikop eri kihong eden wasao Peniel
oh ketihtihki, “I kilangehr Koht ni uhdahn silangi, ahpw iet I momourte.”
Eri, ni eh mweselsang Peniel, ketipin ahpw dakerada, ih eri alu pelingek kohkohla pwehki pwoneo eh piselpesengehr.
Ih kahrepen kadaudok en Israel kan ar sohte tungoale uduk me kin mi ni pwonen mahn, pwehki ih wasa me ohlo poakihdi rehn Seikop.
